All resources and skills came from http://doyoudo.com/
Suggestions are welcomed.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
非常感谢所有留言的大佬，每一个花时间打字写评论的人都是我的天使。评论我也都有在看，每天也都要清理一波小广告。。。然而最近临近毕业最近都在实习上班很难抽出大把时间把你们的建议付诸实际，但我仍然希望这个墙纸能够进一步得到改善，因此将AE的工程文件上传在百度云盘，有需要的可以自取，修改后的新墙纸可以直接上传。
链接：   http://pan.baidu.com/s/1o8AwuSU

I am so grateful to see all your comments, all of you who spent your time to type comments are my angels. I have seen all your suggestions and  praises, and also cleaned those bad ads... Since I am graduating and got an internship right now, even I really want to make improvement of this project, I cannot find enough time to make that happen. So I upload my project file of AE, you can download by your own will. And if any of you have time to make this project a little bit better, you can upload the new one.     http://pan.baidu.com/s/1o8AwuSU

title: Dancing Polish Cow
description:
Here it is, the Dancing Polish Cow. 

                                                                                                     [img]https://images.steamusercontent.com/ugc/13527778766694972232/6B64671D3FF1F005F5A79C82C9D4283B1CEAADE4/[/img]
This is a wallpaper of the "Dancing Polish Cow" meme also known as "Dancing Polish Cow at 4am". It has various effects and audio reactivity, as well as a short loop of the song [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qrxv0JNVtgY] "Cypis - Gdzie jest biały węgorz ?"[/url]

[hr][/hr] [h1]Features:[/h1] [i][list]
[*]The classic dancing cow
[*]Polish Cow soundtrack ([u][b]optional[/b][/u], turn music volume down on the wallpaper settings to use your own music)
[*]Audio reactivity
[*]Various effects to toggle on/off as you please
[*]Polski?
[*]Supports iCue/Chroma with supported devices LEDs reacting to bass.
[*]Custom background image/video. ([u][b]new[/b][/u])
(Cow can be hidden for a clean audio reactive custom background)  
[/list] 
[/i][hr][/hr]

Some of the settings in this wallpaper may not be suitable for some people who suffer from epilepsy.
